title: Beach world - upgraded!?
content: I’m pleased to say that I’ve been frequenting beach world- like almost every night this past week. However, I noticed that my beach world has been “upgraded”. It’s noticeably different and it almost feels like I’ve graduated to a new realm or enhanced 1st person view of the world. Allow me to explain… 1st dream I can recall: I’m walking down the boardwalk and everything is insanely vivid. All my senses were tingling. I could FEEL the humidity and the sprinkles of rain drops hitting my skin. I could SMELL the ocean. I could SEE and take in everything around me; I was not only in a 1st person POV but I could also see overhead and further out (as if a Birds Eye POV) all at the same time. The boardwalk was on a hill and I was walking down towards a crowded corner filled with shops & tourists. I could HEAR the chatter of folks passing by, I was also listening to my grandfather (who passed in 2013) talking to me, giving directions as to where we should go. It was about 730pm, sky was beginning to form a beautiful sunset amidst the clouds that were providing a brief rain shower. 2nd dream: very similar to the first as far as my surroundings and senses go. This dream came about 2 days after the first. Almost like a continuation of that dream. It was raining significantly but it felt like a quick passing downpour. I felt more 1st person POV.. up close and personal, level to the shops on the boardwalk. I was with my dad and we were jolly as ever, basking in the warmth and not bothered by the rain one bit. 3rd dream: I’m heading to the boardwalk from a neighboring street in town. I’m in a horse & carriage with some coworkers. The streets are packed with pedestrians and other horse buggys. I’m taking pictures of my coworkers as we travel in the carriage because I can’t get over how cool / funny it is. We arrive at a corner restaurant on the boardwalk for a “wedding tasting event”. (IRL I’m an event planner so it felt like another day on the job… despite the theatrics with the horses & such) 4th dream: I’m back on the boardwalk but now I’m staying at a neighboring villa. I’m with the cast of vanderpump rules (or atleast that’s what it felt like- I couldn’t make anyone out specifically). We were all hanging out inside the villa, admiring the sunset from the large open windows. We cooked a “family” dinner which consisted of a shrimp & scallop alfredo. There was drama amongst the group of people (similar to the show I suppose) and I was flirting too much with one of the guys apparently. We then ventured into a casino that was attached to the villa. Takeaways/commentary: - I made a post a while back about my previous beach world. I even made a YouTube video about it which was posted on this page. Again, the main differences with THIS beach world is the vividness, the intensity and all of the up close 1st person POVS. -I live on the east coast, so my beach world is reminiscent of the Jersey shore. -all 4 of these dream spots “overlapped” , meaning I felt like I was in the same exactttt location each time -there were definitely moments in these dreams where I was lucid and I remember trying to soak in all of the details around me. Sadly when I woke up, many of those fine details dissipated.
